title: acorellus distachyus
intro: Acorellus distachyus, commonly known as Horseradish Tree, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the relief of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant health benefits. The Horseradish Tree also exhibits therapeutic actions including anti-bacterial, anti-fungal, and anti-parasitic properties. The bioactive constituents of Acorellus distachyus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
